title.narrative: ASEAN Regional Integration Support from the EU (ARISE Plus) - INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS (IPR)

description.narrative: The Overall Objective of ARISE PLUS is to support greater economic integration in ASEAN through the implementation of the ASEAN Economic Community Blueprint 2025 and strengthening institutional capacity.The Specific Objective of ARISE + IPR is to support ASEAN regional integration and further upgrade and improve the systems for IP creation, protection, utilization, administration and enforcement in the ASEAN region, in line with international IP best practice and standards and with the recently approved ASEAN IPR Action Plan 2016-2025.
